note: Assertions were drafted after one manual pass on evals/files/leave-app (see evals/files/leave-app.report.md). Run each prompt with and without the skill, then prune assertions that pass in both.

evals.prompt: I just joined the team, the repository is at evals/files/leave-app and has no documentation at all. Can you explain the business flow so I can share it with a non-technical PM?
evals.expected_output: English report.md and report.html: summary tab with one journey diagram, one section per flow with diagram and rules table, technical detail tab with coverage and open questions.
assertions: scripts/validate_report.py exits 0 on the produced report.md
The report is written in English
The report states that leave longer than 3 days needs HR approval and cites policies.py
The report includes the scheduled escalation job as a flow with no user trigger
The report includes a state diagram with Draft, Submitted, Escalated, Approved and Rejected
The report has at least one [UNKNOWN] item about deduct_balance or the leave balance
No secret value from the .env file appears anywhere in the output

evals.prompt: Document how a leave request goes from draft to approved in evals/files/leave-app, including anything that happens without a user clicking a button.
evals.expected_output: English report covering the submit and decide flows and the automatic escalation, with code references.
assertions: The report mentions the 5 day escalation threshold with a reference to jobs.py
The report says that the job schedule is not defined in the code read, or tags the daily schedule as INFERRED
Every [FACT] line has a path:line reference that resolves in the repo
The report distinguishes the manager-only decision from the HR decision for long leave

evals.prompt: What are the business rules around leave balance in evals/files/leave-app? I only care about that part, not the whole app.
evals.expected_output: A narrower report (or one clearly scoped to balance) that still follows the layered structure and flags gaps.
assertions: The report states the 12 day annual allowance with a reference to models.py
The report says pending requests do not reduce the remaining balance
The report says weekends are counted as leave days, or asks whether they should be
The coverage section states the scope was limited to leave balance
